title: Siyam 4
author: Beyza Aksoy
description: Series synopsis: Karaca is a fourth-year medical student whose life spirals out of control when tragedy strikes at her estranged brother’s boxing match. Drawn into a web of grief, betrayal, and dangerous secrets, she must choose between silence and the perilous pursuit of truth. Across four gripping volumes, Karaca confronts hidden enemies, fractured loyalties, and the suffocating weight of memory. As each revelation pushes her closer to the edge, the line between justice and vengeance begins to blur, culminating in a powerful finale where the cost of truth may demand everything. A dark and emotional saga of survival, identity, and reckoning.
